definitions.gloss: to remove, to get rid of

definitions.explanation: To leave out from a group.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除|のぞ}いて⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧
⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除|のぞ}く。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除|のぞ}けば、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除|のぞ}いて⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They are open every day except Sunday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不良品|ふりょうひん}→不良品：19452_furyouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除|のぞ}いて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出荷|しゅっか}する→出荷：05135_shukka⟧。
examples.english: We ship after removing defective products.

notes:
{除|のぞ}く means to remove, exclude, or eliminate something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を for the thing being removed or excluded

HOMOPHONE ALERT:
- {除|のぞ}く (this word): to remove, exclude
- {覗|のぞ}く: to peek, peep (different kanji and meaning)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{除|のぞ}いて: excluding ~, except for ~
- 〜を{除|のぞ}く: to remove ~
- 〜を{除|のぞ}けば: if we exclude ~

EXAMPLE CONTEXTS:
- {汚|よご}れを{除|のぞ}く: to remove dirt
- {例外|れいがい}を{除|のぞ}く: to exclude exceptions
- {彼|かれ}を{除|のぞ}いて{全員|ぜんいん}: everyone except him
